concerns.text: Constitution Principle VII (in-lens per FR-030) mandates that R², RMSE, and MAE be reported SEPARATELY for each stress category (drought, salinity, metal toxicity). FR-008 only requires metrics 'for each metabolite' with no per-stress-type breakdown. Add per-stress-category reporting to FR-008/US-2.

The idea explicitly specifies the split as 'training (70%), validation (15%), and test (15%)'. The spec defers these to [deferred]. Split ratios are a stated design parameter of the source idea, not an empirical value to be measured — the [deferred] convention covers measured quantities, not pre-specified methodology constants. Restore the 70/15/15 ratios (or justify the change).

The idea specifies Elastic Net 'α tuned via grid search'; the spec applies Bayesian optimization (≤30 evaluations) to all three models. This is a small methodological substitution not present in the source idea — either restore grid search for Elastic Net α or note the deviation as a clarifier-surfaced simplification.
